name: Gamagori
tagline: Bay views, hot springs and a little island.
intro_en: Gamagori faces the sheltered waters of Mikawa Bay. Its symbol is Takeshima, a small wooded island linked to the shore by a long footbridge, with a shrine at its heart.
The town has hot-spring districts along the coast and a waterfront that's lovely at sunset — an easy seaside day trip from Nagoya.
getting_there_en: Gamagori Station is on the JR Tokaido Line, with direct rapid trains from Nagoya Station.
image_alt: Illustration of a small wooded island linked to the shore by a long bridge
